# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old (as of late volume 4)  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v3 c26 P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** Single  <sub>[v1 c25 P45](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0045)</sub>
- **Rank:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c34 P11](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie Pye is described as stout or fat, with a round, plump figure that makes her unsuitable for roles requiring slenderness. She is known for her malicious and catty smiles. Her classmates note her disagreeable facial expressions when observing or mocking others.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047)_

## Personality

Josie is vain, boastful, and frequently malicious toward her peers. She possesses a sharp tongue, a tendency to cheat or act dishonestly, and a spiteful nature that leads her to mock others and stir up trouble. Despite her unpleasant demeanour, she exhibits natural physical agility, such as a knack for walking board fences, and is very confident in her own social and academic standing.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Goals

- To attend college for the sake of education without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Josie Pye attended Avonlea School, where she frequently clashed with Anne Shirley and was caught peeping in her book during spelling lessons. During a game of 'daring' at a party, Josie successfully walked a board fence and challenged Anne to walk the ridgepole of a roof, resulting in Anne falling and breaking her ankle. She joined the Queen's Academy preparation class, passed her entrance examinations, and studied for her Second Class teacher's license alongside her Avonlea peers. After graduating from Queen's, she attended Redmond College in Kingsport with Anne, Priscilla, Stella, and Philippa, maintaining her reputation for having the sharpest tongue in her class. Later, she returned to Redmond for her Sophomore year rather than taking up a teaching position, as her wealthy father could afford her education.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P30](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0030), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)_
